---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
format: html
author: Nicolas
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
#| echo: false
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(continent = "Europe", scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

mallards_filtered <- mallards |>
  filter(lat >= 46, lat <= 55, long >= 7, long <= 25) |>
  mutate(duck_id = as.factor(duck_id))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#d9e5ea", color = "#7a8b94") +
  geom_path(
    data = mallards_filtered,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = duck_id, color = duck_id),
    linewidth = 0.55,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = mallards_filtered,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id),
    size = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.95) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.margin = margin(0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, "cm")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard duck GPS fixes, 2007–2017",
    subtitle = "Each color is one individual duck; lines show movement paths"
  )
```
